div.p: Our multi-stage verification matrix ensures every export shipment meets rigorous international retail specifications with full laboratory traceability.

div.class: p-4 rounded-4 border bg-white h-100 shadow-sm
div.p: Every sewing operator is paired with an independent roving QA auditor checking stitch SPI, seam elasticity, and tension consistency every 30 minutes.

div.class: p-4 rounded-4 border bg-white h-100 shadow-sm
div.p: Full spectrum testing for burst strength, pilling resistance (Martindale), dimensional stability after 5x washing, and color fastness to saliva and perspiration.

div.class: p-4 rounded-4 border bg-white h-100 shadow-sm
div.p: 100% of finished cartons pass through dual-sensor conveyor needle detectors calibrated to 0.8mm ferrous spheres before carton polybag sealing.

div.class: p-4 rounded-4 border bg-white h-100 shadow-sm
div.p: Comprehensive pre-shipment inspection (PSI) conducted under ISO 2859-1 sampling plans with digital photographic reporting provided directly to buyer portals.

div.div: AATCC 135 (Dimensional Change) • ISO 105-C06 (Color Fastness to Domestic Laundering) • ASTM D3786 (Hydraulic Bursting Strength) • ISO 12945-2 (Martindale Pilling) • Oeko-Tex Formaldehyde Screening.
